## Definition of done

- [ ] `npm run verify -- <id>` passes (check, browser tests, offline zip, GLB, pictures)
- [ ] I looked at the pictures in `test-results/<id>/` (phone portrait and landscape included)
- [ ] The Bangla wording matches the book (NCTB terms), digits are Bangla
- [ ] It is simple for a student: the object, the one idea, a short tap-to-answer test
- [ ] Version bumped in `asset.json` (patch: fix, minor: feature, major: breaking bridge/params)
- [ ] Open reviews handled (each set to `done` with a reply naming the version)
- [ ] For a kit change: `npm run test:visual` shows no change in other figures, `shared/lib/VERSION` + `shared/CHANGELOG.md` updated
